claim: WITHDRAWN AS A PORTFOLIO CLAIM (2026-08-18). The earlier wording "Toy matched-budget does not show DiT advantage (UNet restored PSNR > DiT on n=10 pairs)" is not supportable and must not be quoted. The toy DiT never trained: its loss stayed flat at ~0.99 (AdaLN-Zero zero-initializes every block's residual gate, so all blocks start as no-ops), so 6.57 dB measures an initialization stall, not an architecture. The budget was also never matched: params differ (DiT 17,961,024 vs UNet 16,058,179, DiT ~11.8% larger), and matched-steps vs matched-wall-clock give opposite verdicts because the DiT is ~30x faster per step. n=10 test pairs, seed 0, single run, no repeats. What this file does support is only: on one 50-step seed-0 toy run, the UNet reached 14.72 dB and the stalled DiT 6.57 dB, and BOTH are below the 20.75 dB degraded input, i.e. neither toy model restored anything.
supportable_statement: Neither toy model beat its own degraded input at 50 steps (UNet 14.72 dB, DiT 6.57 dB, degraded input 20.75 dB, n=10, seed 0); the DiT figure is an AdaLN-Zero initialization stall, so no DiT-vs-UNet verdict is available from this run.
why_withdrawn: adaln_zero_stall: toy DiT loss flat at ~0.99 at 50 steps; 6.57 dB is a stall artifact, not an architecture ceiling.
budget_definition_disagreement: DiT is ~30x faster per step (1.58s vs 47.46s for 50 steps), so matched-steps and matched-wall-clock give opposite verdicts.
no_statistics: n=10 test pairs, seed 0, one run per model, no repeats, no confidence interval.
both_below_baseline: both toy models score below the 20.75 dB degraded input, so neither restored anything.
orphan_500step_counterevidence: findings_assets/unet_result_500step.json (500 steps, same seed/n) restores to 14.048 dB, slightly worse than the 50-step 14.722 dB — 10x more training did not help.

unet_500step_orphan.implication: 10x the training budget made restored PSNR slightly worse and stayed far below the degraded input; the toy UNet is not a valid matched-budget winner.

official_eval_note: The 2026-08-16 official DiT4SR run produced 13 real output PNGs out of 206 LQ inputs (193 skipped OOM on vGPU-32GB). No PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS was computed and none may be invented; the 13 stems have no ground truth on disk. The official R claim remains unmet, and this toy M measurement must not be used as a stand-in for it.
